text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval for the marketing and corporate partnership mandate for Civic Theatres Toronto.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Authorized the marketing and corporate partnership mandate, as more particularly noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 20, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 20, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to the security of property belonging to the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto.
